subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept a proof override for this PR because the targeted xAI code-less stale encrypted_content error is provider-side and not reliably client-inducible?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot mark the external PR's real behavior proof sufficient without after-fix output or a proof override, but the code path is narrow, the source-level reproduction is strong, and the contributor explained why a faithful live capture requires an organic xAI rotation event.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix production logs, existing sibling retry behavior, focused positive/negative tests, and green CI as enough for maintainer-owned merge review.

options.title: Wait for organic xAI proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future provider rotation produces redacted after-fix gateway logs showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Request a stricter matcher
options.body: Ask for an additional status, provider, or error-shape guard before revisiting proof if maintainers are not comfortable with the cross-provider prose match.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix production logs, existing sibling retry behavior, focused positive/negative tests, and green CI as enough for maintainer-owned merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and merged the adjacent encrypted-reasoning retry behavior that this PR extends.
